City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council Meeting - 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 13, 2023 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER
City Council: Mayor Tony Kranz, Deputy Mayor Joy Lyndes, Council Members Allison Blackwell, Bruce Ehlers, and Kellie Shay Hinze
Mobility & Traffic Safety Commission: Chair June Honsberger, Vice Chair Patricia Trauth, Commissioners James Gross, Glen Johnson, Harold Standerfer, David Thile, and James Wang
Youth Commission: Chair Carter Ballow, Vice Chair Colin Ballow, Commissioners Sarah Charles, Sofia Gonzalez, Quade Kelley, Harrison Kessler, David Leschensky, Will Ryan, and Benjamin Su
AGENDA ITEM:
1.
Bike Safety and Mobility Update on Education and Outreach, and Potential Safety Enhancement Projects. Environmental Considerations: It has been determined that the recommendations are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. The recommended actions meet the criteria for this exemption. Contact Persons: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan and Mobility Manager Buck
1) Receive update on bike safety and mobility education and outreach efforts; and 2) Provide direction on the potential safety enhancement projects.
2023-09-13 Special Joint Meeting - Item #01 Bike Safety & Mobility Update
2023-09-13 Special Joint Meeting - Item #01 Bike Safety & Mobility Update - Public Comment
2023-09-13 Special Joint Meeting - Item #01 Bike Safety & Mobility Update - Staff Presentation
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
